traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Cyclanthaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple or compound; compound leaves palmate; veins usually single, rarely palmate; leaf rosettes basal or none; plants monoecious; ovary half inferior or inferior; stems woody or herbaceous; perianth tepals or absent; fruit berry; stamens 10 to 20 (-150); carpels 4. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
